requirements.text: When an operator requests an export of a completed run, the reconciliation system shall produce a CSV file.
The run export shall include every matched pair and every unmatched transaction with its probable-cause label.
The reconciliation system shall delete exports older than 90 days.
When the bank statement feed is more than 30 minutes late, the reconciliation system shall page the on-call engineer.
If a run still has unlabelled unmatched transactions, then the reconciliation system shall reject its approval.
